guard: Windows detached up requests job breakaway safely, returns a signalable active child contract, and fails loud when exit cannot be observed
why: The pure decision seam deterministically covers Windows job states on every CI platform; the native branch still runs in the Windows workflow.
The named refusal cell requires both the loud failure and the --foreground remediation.
The child contract is exercised with an injected signalling function, so no real process is spawned or killed on a non-Windows host.
The exit-observation cell requires an explicit limitation error rather than a silent value that could be read as successful teardown.

mutations.name: job-bound Windows launch silently proceeds without breakaway
mutations.expectRed: Windows job without breakaway permission refuses detached up and names --foreground
mutations.cell: Windows job without breakaway permission refuses detached up and names --foreground
mutations.note: Deletes the fail-loud safety gate while leaving the rest of the launch decision intact.

mutations.name: allowed Windows job omits CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB
mutations.expectRed: Windows job with breakaway permission requests CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB
mutations.cell: Windows job with breakaway permission requests CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB
mutations.note: Reverts the allowed-job branch to a normal detached process that remains in the hostile parent job.

mutations.name: Windows detached child kill is inert
mutations.find: kill(signal: NodeJS.Signals | number = "SIGTERM") { return signalProcess(pid, signal); },
mutations.expectRed: Windows detached child kill forwards the exact pid and signal
mutations.cell: Windows detached child kill forwards the exact pid and signal
mutations.note: Restores the stub whose kill method never signals the native detached pid.

mutations.name: Windows detached child omits active exit state
mutations.expectRed: Windows detached child is active under the same null-state guard as a real child
mutations.cell: Windows detached child is active under the same null-state guard as a real child
mutations.note: Restores the absent fields that make undefined !== null skip teardown before signalling.

mutations.name: unobservable Windows detached child is treated as observable
mutations.find:
if (typeof child.once !== "function" || typeof child.off !== "function")
    throw new Error(`detached child process ${child.pid ?? "unknown"} cannot have its exit observed`);
mutations.expectRed: Windows detached child exit observation fails loud instead of pretending it exited
mutations.cell: Windows detached child exit observation fails loud instead of pretending it exited
mutations.note: Deletes the explicit limitation so waiting code can silently proceed without any exit observation.
